title: Staying on Spec: Real-Time Monitoring under Uncertainty with a Maritime Case Study
description:
arXiv:2608.02811v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Robotic systems must operate under uncertainty while satisfying complex task and safety specifications. Monitoring such specifications under uncertainty remains challenging, as existing formulations typically require extensive data or explicit uncertainty distributions.
